# libvterm 0.3.3

Terminal emulator library by Paul Evans, MIT license (see `LICENSE`), from
https://www.leonerd.org.uk/code/libvterm/libvterm-0.3.3.tar.gz
(sha256 `09156f43dd2128bd347cbeebe50d9a571d32c64e0cf18d211197946aff7226e0`).

Only the library sources are kept (`include/`, `src/` with the generated
encoding tables); tests, tools and the Makefile are left out. Used by the
Android app's terminal (`src/mobile/TerminalSession.*`).
